content:
The [CSV to JSON Converter](/csv-to-json-converter) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Convert CSV data to JSON — paste CSV, get structured JSON back. Enter your CSV input and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Convert CSV data into JSON — the format APIs and JavaScript code expect. Paste comma-separated values with a header row, and get back an array of objects keyed by the headers. Quoted fields (with commas, quotes or new lines inside) are parsed properly, so data exported from Excel or Google Sheets converts cleanly. If the CSV is malformed, the tool says so instead of guessing. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the CSV to JSON Converter

Start by typing or pasting your CSV input. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. The steps below walk through each input in order.

1. Paste your CSV — the first row must be the headers.
2. Read the JSON output — an array of objects, pretty-printed.
3. Copy the output into your code or API test.

## How it works

The [CSV to JSON Converter](/csv-to-json-converter) works straight from the values you enter: change an input and the result updates immediately, with no page reload and no waiting. Everything happens in your browser, so your entries never leave your device. Try it with a few different values and you will quickly get a feel for how the inputs move the result.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. A CSV with the header “name,age,city” and the row “Ana,30,Lahore” becomes [{"name": "Ana", "age": "30", "city": "Lahore"}] — every value is text, as CSV carries no types. Try the same figures in the [CSV to JSON Converter](/csv-to-json-converter) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves.

## What the result shows

With the default values (CSV input: name,age,city Ana,30,Lahore Bilal,25,Karachi), the [CSV to JSON Converter](/csv-to-json-converter) returns JSON output: [ { "name": "Ana", "age": "30", "city": "Lahore" }, { "name": "Bilal", "age": "25", "city": "Karachi" } ], Rows: 2 objects, Status: Valid CSV. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [URL Encoder](/url-encoder) is worth a look before you finish.

## What the converter expects

The first row is the header row: its values become the keys of every object. Each following row is one object, and missing cells become empty strings. Values are kept as text — CSV has no types, so “30” stays the string "30" and your code can convert it. Empty lines are skipped, and quoted fields may contain commas, quotes (doubled) or new lines.

## Why values stay as text

A CSV file does not record whether 30 is a number, a date or a product code, so the converter does not guess: every cell becomes a string. That is the safe choice — guessing wrong would silently change your data. Convert numbers in your own code (for example, Number(obj.age) in JavaScript) where you know what each column means.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- The first row must be the headers — they become the JSON keys.
- Values stay as text: convert numbers in your own code.
- Quoted fields with commas inside them parse correctly.

## Frequently asked questions

### What CSV can I convert to JSON?

Any CSV with a header row: the first row becomes the keys, each following row becomes one object. Quoted fields with commas or new lines inside them work. Try it with your own numbers in the [CSV to JSON Converter](/csv-to-json-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Why are the numbers strings in the JSON?

CSV has no types — 30 could be a number, a code or a date. The converter keeps every cell as text rather than guessing, and you convert in your own code. Try it with your own numbers in the [CSV to JSON Converter](/csv-to-json-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Can I convert JSON back to CSV?

Yes — the JSON to CSV converter on this site does the reverse. Try it with your own numbers in the [CSV to JSON Converter](/csv-to-json-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Is my data uploaded anywhere?

No. The conversion runs entirely in your browser — the CSV never leaves your device. You can use it as often as you like, and because nothing is uploaded, stored or tracked, there is nothing to delete afterwards.
